2173-4574-7435-8095--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-4574-7435-8095--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

4279-4976-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3263-3899-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-3899-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-3899-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

5078-6766-6968-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

645-1267-3908-4247.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3908-4247.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

3781-3899-4215--124.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
3781-3899-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

465-618-3899.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1376-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
1376-4091-7791.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Priest of Titania.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

3213-3587-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3213-3587-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Boros Reckoner indestructible using Boromir.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3213-3587-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

1170-1482-4808-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1482-4808-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4624-7428.description:
Cast Revenge by paying {4}{W}{B}, doubling your life total.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.

1765-2440-3480-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-3480-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

1477-2646-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1477-2646-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3497-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4677-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-4677-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

437-549-1651-5640.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Sphinx's Disciple, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat
437-549-1651-5640.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-4885.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-4885.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

1921-2034-3464.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Hyrax Tower Scout from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Hyrax Tower Scout token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Hyrax Tower Scout token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1349-6012-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-6012-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reluctant Role Model.
When Reluctant Role Model dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Reluctant Role Model from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 6.
Repeat.

5544-5670-6794.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
5544-5670-6794.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, targeting an opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn ability, causing you to gain 1 life and causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

654-1231-2034-6644.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {C}{C}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

101-198-4067-6281.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vampire Charmseeker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

585-2102-3814.notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land.
585-2102-3814.description:
Activate Griffin Canyon's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Argothian Elder to become a Griffin until end of turn.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Griffin Canyon and another land.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

261-1116-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
261-1116-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

67-413-2525.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, it triggers its Reveillark ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2308-2440-5468.manaNeeded: {2} plus an additional {1} if there are no other Fungi or Beasts on the battlefield
2308-2440-5468.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
2308-2440-5468.description:
Cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
Kambal's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Kambal's second ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Fungus and Beast on the battlefield.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

262-360-859.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-360-859.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Soul Warden four times.
Resolve the first Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

864-2034-2104-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's last ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2438-4681-4881.description:
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, targeting Activated Sleeper.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

864-4377-5163.notablePrerequisites: Roon does not have summoning sickness.
864-4377-5163.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Roon by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Eternal Witness until the beginning of your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Roon triggers, returning Eternal Witness from exile to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, putting Walk the Aeons into your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

596-1651-1737-3698.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Darksteel Citadel.
The Darksteel Citadel token enters, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Darksteel Citadel token and Grinding Station, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

57-1402-2178-2257.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-1402-2178-2257.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each of your opponent.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.
